payload.summary: Answered follow-up investigation about ChatGPT subscription transcription without an API key. Official auth documentation distinguishes ChatGPT/Codex subscription access from general Platform API calls; file-transcription guide authenticates /v1/audio/transcriptions with OPENAI_API_KEY. Voice is included on eligible ChatGPT plans inside OpenAI clients, but no documented third-party file-transcription entitlement via ChatGPT OAuth was found. Existing OpenCut OAuth adapter forwards Codex Responses requests; it does not establish audio endpoint entitlement. No credentials were extracted/replayed, no private audio uploaded and no product code changed. Sources: https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/auth ; https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/features/voice ; https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/speech-to-text . Existing implementation verification retained.
